result.summary: Found 2 minor UI inconsistencies regarding card action buttons and badge content.

issues.description: Inconsistent favorite button styling between cards in 'Popular right now'; the pizza card has a circular dark background while the ramen card does not.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular backdrop to favorite icons across all feed cards.

issues.description: The pizza card displays a '-100%' discount badge, which appears to be placeholder test data.
issues.suggestion: Replace with a realistic discount percentage or appropriate promotional label.
